news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board authorized a Q2 2026 stock dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (roughly 80,463 new shares, based on accrued dividends divided by $2.38) rather than cash. The dividend is payable July 29, 2026 to Series B holders of record as of July 21, 2026, conserving cash but modestly diluting common shareholders.

catalysts.label: Series B preferred stock dividend payment
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will issue approximately 80,463 new common shares to Series B Preferred holders of record as of July 21, 2026, in lieu of a cash dividend.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's recent reporting cadence (Q1 2026 results were released May 12, roughly six weeks after quarter-end), NeurAxis is expected to report Q2 2026 financial results and host a business update call in mid-August 2026; an exact date has not yet been announced.

catalysts.label: Further payer/insurer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Following the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS taking effect January 1, 2026 and additional insurer policy wins covering roughly 1.25 million lives announced in April 2026, NeurAxis has a pattern of periodically announcing new medical policy coverage decisions that could continue to expand its reimbursed addressable market.

pulse: NeurAxis has had a notably quiet six weeks since mid-June 2026, following a very active spring in which the company posted record Q1 2026 revenue of $1.6M (+80% YoY), benefited from its new AMA Category I CPT reimbursement code, and added insurer coverage for roughly 1.25 million additional lives. The main recent corporate action was a routine July 9 stock dividend on Series B Preferred shares, paid in common stock rather than cash. Attention now turns to Q2 2026 results, expected around mid-August, to confirm whether the reimbursement-driven revenue ramp and margin improvement seen in Q1 are continuing.
